name: home_details
description: All entities of a Home Assistant device or area with their current state, unit and attributes, including sensors that are not in home_state (energy use, run time, Wi-Fi, diagnostics). Returns entity ids for home_history.

name.description: A device or area name exactly as in <devices>, or part of an entity name or id.

name: home_history
description: Past states of Home Assistant entities, summed up per day or per hour. Numbers: time-weighted mean, min, max, the value at the start and end, and the change (for a growing counter such as a kWh total, the change is the use in that period). Other states (on/off, printing): hours spent in each. Home Assistant keeps about 10 days.

entity_ids.description: 1 to 10 entity ids, e.g. from home_details.

to.description: Local end in the same format, or "now".

period.description: hour: at most 3 days. day: at most 31 days.
